infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Temptation Token needs your photo library so you can choose the photo you are entering into the contest, and upload the government ID and selfie required for the one-time 18+ age check.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Temptation Token uses the camera so you can take the selfie and photograph the government ID required for the one-time 18+ age check, and shoot a photo to enter the contest.
